ConnectionStrings._comment: Leave empty here. Set on the server as the environment variable ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection (same DB as the API). The worker writes ONLY to assistant_* tables.

Gemini._comment: ApiKey stays empty: set Assistant__Gemini__ApiKey (the billing-enabled key the API uses). Model, size and the document text format must match the API's query embeddings.

Qdrant._comment: gRPC port. ApiKey stays empty: set Assistant__Qdrant__ApiKey (same value as QDRANT__SERVICE__API_KEY on the Qdrant service).
